Karthik / Marcus — forwarding Helix's onboarding packet. They want to know if we can: (A) put both SKUs on one PO with internal spend splits, and (B) provide a provisional PO for immediate billing.

Quick context: Helix is expected to start billing next week for an initial technical services engagement plus support. I want to avoid creating two separate invoice flows if we can keep a single PO that our ledger / AP can split.

Can you confirm whether Procurement will accept a single PO reference with per-line spend caps, and whether we can generate a provisional PO number before DocuSign completion? If not, what is the fastest workaround to avoid blocking their first invoice?

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Helix onboarding: vendor form + PO request

Neha — short answer: we can do a single PO with line-item spend allocations, but there are two caveats:

1) Our ledger requires a primary PO number for accounting. AP can accept multiple invoice lines under that PO if the vendor uses the SKU codes we map to our cost centers. We then route charges to the appropriate spend bucket in the GL.

2) Provisional PO numbers are possible (provisional- prefix) for up to 30 days, but they require the AM or deal owner to sign off on a spend cap and billing cadence. The provisional PO gets converted to a final PO once DocuSign is complete. For amounts above $75k there is an extra approval step.

Marcus — can you confirm the spend-cap enforcement mechanics? Specifically, can the system automatically prevent payments over the per-line cap or do we rely on manual AP checks?

-Karthik
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Helix onboarding: vendor form + PO request

Karthik / Neha — FYI on enforcement: our PO processing system supports line-level caps that are validated at invoice match time. If an invoice exceeds the per-line cap the system flags it and routes to a manual AP exception queue. We do not automatically block payment — we surface the exception to AP and to the cost center owner for approval.

For provisional POs: AP can create a provisional PO number (format PROV-<year>-#####) and tag it to the expected final PO. We can set the provisional cap to the smaller of the agreed total or 30-day burn estimate. To make this operationally clean, we need one of the following:
- AM sign-off on provisional cap (easiest)
- Finance-level approval for provisional increases above $75k

Action items:
- Neha: confirm the per-line caps Helix wants (CSV shows two lines; please confirm amounts).
- Karthik: confirm who in AM will sign the provisional PO (name + email).
- Laura: I'll include AP handling notes for the vendor packet.

-Marcus Lin

- Final PO intent: PO-78921 (will replace provisional once signed).
- Line items and caps (please mirror these exact SKU codes on invoices):

  * HELX-PS-01 (premium-support): cap $12,000
- Total provisional cap: $40,000. Note: any invoice that causes a per-line overage will enter an AP exception and require cost-center approval before payment.
